chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the charity that was forbidden upon the Banu Hashim, what is it? He said, 'It is the zakat.' I said, 'Then is the charity of some of them permissible upon others?' He said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.بَنُو هَاشِم: Banu Hashim (the clan of the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between zakat and sadaqah for Banu Hashim according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam clarifies that the prohibition on Banu Hashim receiving 'sadaqah' specifically refers to 'zakat' (the obligatory alms), a distinction rooted in the Quranic verse 9:60 which lists the eight categories of recipients. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) further elucidates that this restriction is not absolute; Banu Hashim are permitted to receive sadaqah from one another, highlighting the flexibility within Shia fiqh regarding intra-clan charity.
